[DevOps-Gym / monitor]
Task: embedded-smoke-monitor-1
Project: demo-api
Language: go

Production shows growing goroutine count and RSS while QPS is flat. HTTP handlers spawn a goroutine per request with no wait group or cancellation. Propose a concrete code change pattern to bound concurrency (worker pool or semaphore) and propagate context cancel.

gold_review.explanation: With default args (no hf_dataset_id / DEVOPS_GYM_ROOT) the env silently falls back to embedded smoke tasks whose answers are prose, while the default oracle_overlap reward only counts +/- unified-diff lines from the answer — so _patch_lines_for_overlap returns [] and reward is identically 0 for any reply, including the exact reference inside <answer>. Meaningful scoring needs an external DevOps-Gym clone/HF export or an OpenAI judge.
gold_review.evidence: devops_gym.py:493-495 reward_mode='oracle_overlap', fallback_embedded=True; :549-556 embedded smoke rows; :449-461 only lines starting with +/- kept; :473-474 no patch lines → 0.0; answer 'Use a semaphore or worker pool ...'; gold_xml.log oracle_overlap_score r1=[0.0]
